title: Common words, verbs and plurals
intro: Some frequent words need extra practice. Read each word in a sentence and notice any unusual spelling. Word endings can show more than one thing or a change in an action.
support: عامې کلمې په جمله کې ولولئ او ځانګړې لیکنه یې وګورئ. پایونه د ډېرو شیانو یا د کار بدلون ښودلی شي.
text:
I see one box. I see two boxes.
The cat jumps. It jumped. It is jumping.
We have one pen and two pens.
the · was · one · said
model: Box becomes boxes when there is more than one. Jump keeps its base spelling in jumps, jumped and jumping. In said, pay attention to the unusual ai spelling.
activity: Read all four common words, cover them, write them and look again to check. Start a spelling log for a word you want to remember.
adult: Ask the learner to read the verb forms in context. Help them look up a spelling and add it to a small log for future work.
adultPs: ماشوم دې فعلونه په جمله کې ولولي. د یوې کلمې سمه لیکنه پیدا او په وړوکي لړ کې یې ولیکئ.

tasks: Read the and was in sentences that an adult writes. Copy both once.
Write one pen and then two pens. Circle the added letter.
Draw one box and three boxes. Label both drawings.
Read jumps, jumped and jumping. Underline their endings.
Cover one and said. Write each from memory and check it.
Ask someone to help spell an unfamiliar classroom word. Write it in your log.
Read the short passage aloud. Explain what boxes tells you and use it in a new sentence.
Write the plural forms of cat and dish. Say why each changes.
Read: I look. He looks. He looked. He is looking. Point to each ending.
Write a new sentence containing said. Check it against the word in your spelling log.
